# Sabores da Rota - Workspace Instructions

- Use `npm install` to install dependencies.
- Use `npm run dev` to start the Vite development server.
- The app uses React, Vite, React Router and styled-components.
- The main entry point for routes is `src/App.jsx`.
- Design tokens are in `src/styles/theme.js` and `src/styles/global.js`.
- Pages are in `src/pages` and reusable UI components are in `src/components`.
